translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: Compared with the placebo, TU-100 7.5 g/d was associated with consistent, encouraging trends in efficacy outcomes, including more patients achieving GI recovery by postoperative day 2, with fewer bothersome GI symptoms.
translations.translation_ko: 위약과 견줘 TU-100 7.5 g/d 를 먹은 쪽에서 수술 이튿날 장 기능이 돌아온 사람이 더 많았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Nutrition alone resulted in significant weight retention (2.60; 2.32, 2.88, p < 0.00001), length of stay (-4.00; -6.87, -1.13), p = 0.0006) and complications (0.64; 0.49, 0.83, p = 0.0009).
translations.translation_ko: 영양 지원만 해도 체중이 덜 빠졌고, 입원 기간이 짧아졌으며, 합병증도 줄었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Compared to placebo or no treatment, renin-angiotensin system (RAS) inhibition probably decreases proteinuria (3 studies, 199 participants: MD - 0.71 g/24 h, 95% CI -1.04 to -0.39; moderate certainty evidence) but may result in little or no difference to kidney failure or doubling of serum creatinine (SCr), or complete remission of proteinuria (low certainty evidence).
translations.translation_ko: 레닌안지오텐신계 억제제를 쓴 쪽에서 단백뇨가 줄었지만(3개 연구, 199명), 신부전이나 혈청 크레아티닌 배가에서는 차이가 뚜렷하지 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between groups in 1-month mortality (p = 0.324), hospital length of stay (median 7 vs.
translations.translation_ko: 한 달 사망률과 재원 기간에서 군 사이에 뚜렷한 차이가 없었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: The most common treatment-emergent adverse events were gastrointestinal disorders, including abdominal distension (FSMP: 17.3% vs.
translations.translation_ko: 가장 흔한 이상반응은 소화기 증상이었고, 배가 부푸는 증상이 FSMP 군에서 17.3% 로 나왔습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Treatment-related adverse events were comparable in the two groups.
translations.translation_ko: 치료와 관련된 이상반응은 두 군에서 비슷했습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: However, fatigue and malaise are frequent adverse effects.
translations.translation_ko: 다만 피로감과 몸이 처지는 느낌은 자주 나오는 이상반응입니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Secondary outcomes included relative dose intensity (RDI), chemotherapy-induced toxicities, quality of life (measured by the Edmonton Symptom Assessment System - ESAS), adverse events (AEs), and serious AEs (SAEs).
translations.translation_ko: 이차 결과로는 항암제 용량 강도, 항암 부작용, 삶의 질, 이상반응, 중대한 이상반응을 봤습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: More patients reported adverse effects with midazolam 15 mg.
translations.translation_ko: 미다졸람 15 mg 을 쓴 쪽에서 이상반응을 말한 사람이 더 많았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
translations.translation_ko: 고령 대장암 환자가 수술 전에 운동과 영양 준비를 했을 때 수술 후 합병증이나 입원 기간이 뚜렷하게 줄지는 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: There was no difference in the response rate or frequency of serious adverse events between the two arms.
translations.translation_ko: 반응률과 중대한 이상반응 빈도는 두 군 사이에 차이가 없었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Addition of folic acid and vitamin B12 significantly reduced toxicity without adversely affecting survival time.
translations.translation_ko: 엽산과 비타민 B12 를 같이 준 쪽에서 항암 부작용이 줄었고, 생존 기간은 나빠지지 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: There was no obvious difference in the incidence of adverse events between the two groups, which is common after GI tract surgeries.
translations.translation_ko: 이상반응 발생률은 두 군 사이에 뚜렷한 차이가 없었습니다. 소화관 수술 뒤에 흔히 있는 일입니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Mental state, prefracture functioning on physical and psychosocial domains, comorbidity, female gender, nutritional status, postoperative pain, length of hospital stay, and complications were factors associated with HS or HRQOL.
translations.translation_ko: 정신 상태, 골절 전 생활 능력, 동반질환, 여성, 영양 상태, 수술 후 통증, 입원 기간, 합병증이 건강 상태와 삶의 질에 이어졌습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
translations.translation_ko: 영양 관리를 했더니 사망 위험이 줄고 합병증이 35% 줄었으며, 입원 기간도 2일쯤 짧아지면서 비용이 함께 내려갔습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: In the TMC compound therapy for DKD patients with massive proteinuria, the results show that the probability of adverse experiments in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (OR= 0.55 95% CI 0.30-1.03), P=0.79).
translations.translation_ko: 단백뇨가 많은 당뇨병성 신장질환에서 한약을 같이 쓴 군의 이상반응이 대조군보다 낮게 나왔습니다(오즈비 0.55).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
translations.translation_ko: 뇨독청 과립을 쓴 쪽의 치료 효과가 더 좋게 나왔고(RR 1.249), 세 개 시험에서 이상반응 발생률은 비슷했습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Safety endpoints were hematological data, blood biochemistry data, vital signs, and adverse events.
translations.translation_ko: 안전성 지표로는 혈액 검사, 생화학 검사, 활력징후, 이상반응을 봤습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: There was no significant difference in the incidence of adverse events between the two groups (RR =1.02, 95% CI: 0.93, 1.12; P=0.674).
translations.translation_ko: 이상반응 발생률은 두 군 사이에 뚜렷한 차이가 없었습니다(RR 1.02).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: In the present study, increased serum 25(OH)D level was significantly associated with lower all-cause mortality and lower cardiovascular mortality in dialysis patients.
translations.translation_ko: 투석 환자에서 혈중 비타민 D 25(OH)D 가 높을수록 전체 사망과 심혈관 사망이 낮게 나왔습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Sensitivity analyses were conducted for risk pooling methods, omission of dialysis costs, and persistence of drug effects on mortality.
translations.translation_ko: 위험을 합산하는 방식, 투석 비용을 뺀 경우, 약효가 이어지는 기간을 바꿔 가며 사망에 대한 민감도 분석을 했습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
translations.translation_ko: FPC 군은 헤모글로빈이 처음 수준을 지켰고, 위약군은 0.4 g/dL 낮아졌습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: The incidence of adverse events did not differ between the two groups, and the daily administration of 0.5 µg of alfacalcidol was well-tolerated.
translations.translation_ko: 이상반응 발생률은 두 군에서 다르지 않았고, 알파칼시돌 0.5 µg 을 매일 먹은 쪽도 잘 견뎠습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: There are 47 (40.5%) patients in the ferric citrate group, and 26 (21.3%) patients in the sevelamer carbonate group experienced drug-related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs); most were mild and tolerable.
translations.translation_ko: 약과 관련된 이상반응은 페릭시트르산군 47명(40.5%), 세벨라머탄산염군 26명(21.3%)에서 나왔고 대부분 가벼웠습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Adverse events were reported in 85% (88/103) and 72% (36/50) participants in the upacicalcet and placebo groups, respectively.
translations.translation_ko: 이상반응은 우파시칼세트군 85%(88/103), 위약군 72%(36/50)에서 나왔습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus.
translations.translation_ko: 황기를 먹은 쪽에서 48주 동안 콩팥 기능이 낮아지는 속도가 연간 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 만큼 느렸습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Those with 25(OH)D deficiency were more likely to have diabetes (56% vs 38%), cardiovascular disease (54% vs 36%) and lower serum calcium (2.29 ± 0.13 vs 2.34 ± 0.13 mmol/L).
translations.translation_ko: 비타민 D 가 모자란 쪽에 당뇨병(56% 대 38%)과 심혈관질환(54% 대 36%)이 더 흔했고, 혈중 칼슘은 낮았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs.
translations.translation_ko: 혈액투석 환자는 산화 스트레스와 염증 위험이 높고, 면역억제제를 먹는 사람은 콩팥 독성 위험도 커집니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Key outcomes included CRP, serum albumin, TNF-α, IL-1β, immunoreactive Parathyroid Hormone (iPTH), adverse events, hypercalcemia, and hyperphosphatemia.
translations.translation_ko: 주요 결과로는 CRP, 혈청 알부민, TNF-α, IL-1β, 부갑상선호르몬, 이상반응, 고칼슘혈증, 고인산혈증을 봤습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents.
translations.translation_ko: 이상반응이 조금 늘었고(위험비 1.28), 도파민 계열 약에서 가장 많았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
translations.translation_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 엽산을 하루 800 µg 넘게 또는 3~6개월 넘게 먹으면 임신성 당뇨병이 늘 수 있다고 본 연구가 여럿 있었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: We found an association between particulate matter (PM)2.5 and higher odds of suboptimal vitamin D levels (ie, below 20 ng/mL) (odds ratio per 5 μg/m3 increase in PM2.5, 1.43; 95% CI: 1.02, 1.99).
translations.translation_ko: 초미세먼지 PM2.5 가 짙을수록 비타민 D 가 모자란 경우가 더 많았습니다(오즈비 1.43).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Findings indicated that higher intakes of total fat (relative risk [RR], 1.08; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.02-1.14), animal fat (RR, 1.56; 95%CI, 1.34-1.89), vegetable fat (RR, 1.23; 95%CI, 1.05-1.45), dietary cholesterol (RR, 1.48; 95%CI, 1.10-2.00), and omega-3 fatty acid (RR, 1.11; 95%CI, 1.02-1.20) are associated with a greater risk of GDM.
translations.translation_ko: 지방을 많이 먹을수록 임신성 당뇨병 위험이 높게 나왔고, 동물성 지방에서 가장 뚜렷했습니다(RR 1.56).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
translations.translation_ko: DHA 나 EPA 를 650 mg/일 넘게 먹은 쪽에서 아기 출생 체중이 조금 높게 나왔습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: After adjusting for age, race, and other confounding factors, meta-analysis results showed that vitamin D deficiency in the first trimester, the second trimester, and the third trimester did not increase the risk of PTB (odds ratio (OR) = 1.01, 95% confidence interval (CI) (0.88, 1.16), P = .867; OR = 1.12, 95%CI (0.92, 1.37), P = .249; OR = 1.05, 95%CI (0.87, 1.27), P = .602).
translations.translation_ko: 임신 어느 시기든 비타민 D 가 부족해도 조기분만 위험이 높아지지는 않았습니다(오즈비 1.01, 1.12, 1.05).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage.
translations.translation_ko: 임신 전후로 특정 한약을 쓴 경우 출생아 비율이 늘고(RR 1.14) 선천 기형 위험이 낮았으며(RR 0.46), 유산도 줄었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Analysis demonstrated significant associations between vitamin D deficiency (< 50 nmol/L) and elevated risk of preeclampsia (OR 0.65), gestational diabetes mellitus (OR 1.61), preterm birth (RR 0.67), and small-for-gestational-age neonates (RR 0.61).
translations.translation_ko: 비타민 D 가 모자란 임신부에서 임신성 당뇨병 위험이 높게 나왔습니다(오즈비 1.61).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
translations.translation_ko: DHA 를 800 mg/d 로 많이 먹은 임신부는 200 mg/d 를 먹은 쪽보다 심박수가 낮고 심박변이도가 높았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Pooled result showed that mothers with NTDs offspring demonstrated significantly a higher mean log plasma tHcy level than mothers with normal offspring (log WMD: 0.06; 95%CI: 0.02-0.09, p = 0.001), corresponding to an increase of 6% (2-9%) in the geometric mean.
translations.translation_ko: 신경관 결손 아기를 낳은 어머니의 혈중 호모시스테인이 더 높았고, 기하평균으로 6% 높은 수준이었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).
translations.translation_ko: 임신 중 복합 미량영양소를 먹은 것이 유산(8건)이나 사산(15건) 위험을 바꿨다는 증거는 뚜렷하지 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: This systematic review and stratified meta-analysis critically synthesized data on vitamin D, vitamin B12, and homocysteine to elucidate their relationships with ASD risk and symptomatology.
translations.translation_ko: 비타민 D, 비타민 B12, 호모시스테인이 자폐스펙트럼장애 위험이나 증상과 어떻게 이어지는지 모아 봤습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: The primary data extracted from the selected studies included the following: study design, participants' age, sample size, vitamin D status in relation to developmental defects of enamel, and statistical significance Results: The findings were mixed, with only a few studies suggesting a significant association between low vitamin D levels and the presence of DDEs.
translations.translation_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸고, 비타민 D 가 낮은 것과 치아 에나멜 형성 이상 사이의 관련을 짚은 논문은 몇 편뿐이었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: BACKGROUND: Vitamin A deficiency is a highly detrimental micronutrient deficiency associated with poor growth, impaired immune responses, increased incidence of disease, ocular impairments, and maternal and child mortality.
translations.translation_ko: 비타민 A 가 모자라면 성장이 더디고 면역이 떨어지며 질병이 늘고 눈에 문제가 생기며, 산모와 아이 사망과도 이어집니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: The objective is to review literature and synthesize risk factors for NB.
translations.translation_ko: 신경모세포종의 위험 요인을 문헌에서 모아 정리하는 것이 이 연구의 목적입니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control.
translations.translation_ko: 1976년부터 2020년까지 나온 코호트 6편과 단면연구 5편을 모아 보니, 엽산 길항제에 노출된 쪽에서 선천 심장질환이 늘었습니다(오즈비 1.55).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: Magnesium deficiency may increase the risk of alcohol-related liver injury and adverse liver outcomes.
translations.translation_ko: 마그네슘이 모자라면 술로 인한 간 손상 위험이 커질 수 있습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Long-term use of HPN can lead to a number of adverse health outcomes including the development of metabolic bone disease, intestinal failure associated liver disease and poor quality of life but whether, and how, the composition of HPN solutions contributes to these health sequelae is poorly understood.
translations.translation_ko: 집에서 오래 정맥영양을 하면 대사성 골질환, 장부전 관련 간질환, 삶의 질 저하가 생길 수 있는데, 영양액 조성이 얼마나 관여하는지는 아직 잘 모릅니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Results showed that microbiome-targeted therapies could significantly reduce levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT; effect size [ES], -10.21; 95% confidence interval [CI], -13.29, -7.14; P < 0.001), aspartate aminotransferase (AST; ES, -8.86; 95%CI, -11.39, -6.32; P < 0.001), and γ-glutamyltransferase (ES, -5.56; 95%CI, -7.92, -3.31; P < 0.001) in patients with NAFLD.
translations.translation_ko: 장내 미생물을 겨냥한 치료로 비알코올 지방간 환자의 간수치 ALT 와 AST 가 낮아졌습니다(각각 -10.21, -8.86).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSION: Curcumin supplementation in doses of 50-3000 mg/day over 8-12 weeks was associated with significant reductions in levels of FBG, HOMA-IR, TG, TC, LDL, weight and BMI in patients with NAFLD.
translations.translation_ko: 커큐민을 50~3000 mg/day 로 8~12주 먹은 뒤 공복혈당, 중성지방, 콜레스테롤, 체중이 줄었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: However, people taking PUFA (polyunsaturated fatty acid) may be more likely to experience an adverse event than those not receiving an active intervention (network meta-analysis results: OR 4.44, 95% CrI 2.40 to 8.48; low-certainty evidence; 4 trials, 203 participants; direct evidence: OR 4.43, 95% CrI 2.43 to 8.42).
translations.translation_ko: 다가불포화지방산을 먹은 쪽에서 이상반응을 겪은 사람이 더 많았습니다(오즈비 4.44, 4개 시험 203명).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Our results showed that antioxidants could significantly reduce WC (MD: -1.28 cm; 95% CI: -1.58, -0.99, P < 0.05), ALT (MD: -7.65 IU/L; 95% CI: -11.14, -4.16, P < 0.001), AST (MD: -4.26 IU/L; 95% CI: -5.76, -2.76, P < 0.001), and LDL-C (MD: -0.24 mg/dL; 95% CI: -0.46, -0.02, P < 0.05) increased in patients with NAFLD but had no effect on BMI, TG, and TC.
translations.translation_ko: 항산화제를 먹은 비알코올 지방간 환자에서 허리둘레와 간수치 ALT 가 줄었지만(-7.65 IU/L), 체질량지수와 중성지방은 차이가 없었습니다. 원문은 이 대목에서 늘었다는 표현도 함께 썼습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Moreover, the serum levels of aspartate aminotransferase (p = 0.015) and alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.004) at 6-week intervals, and the serum level of alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.002) at 9-week intervals were significantly lower in the silymarin group.ConclusionOral formulation of silymarin 420 mg/day for 63 days significantly prevented hepatotoxicity caused by doxorubicin in patients with non-metastatic breast cancer mostly based on liver ultrasonography but not laboratory parameters.
translations.translation_ko: 실리마린 420 mg/day 를 63일 먹은 유방암 환자에서 간수치가 낮게 유지됐고, 초음파에서 독소루비신 간독성이 덜했습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Probiotics/synbiotics were associated with a significant reduction in alanine aminotransferase activity [ALT, weighted mean difference (WMD): -11.23 IU/L; 95% CI: -15.02, -7.44 IU/L] and liver stiffness measurement (LSM) by elastography (reflecting inflammation and fibrosis) (WMD: -0.70 kPa; 95% CI: -1.00, -0.40 kPa), although analyses showed heterogeneity (I2 = 90.6% and I2 = 93.4%, respectively).
translations.translation_ko: 유산균이나 신바이오틱스를 먹은 뒤 간수치 ALT 가 줄었고(-11.23 IU/L), 간 굳기도 낮아졌습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: After 72 weeks, changes in IAUC GLP-2 independently predicted the presence of CKD (OR = 0.49, 95%CI:0.21-0.73, p = 0.010) and eGFR changes [β(SE) = 0.510(0.007, p = 0.006] at end-of-treatment, In MASH, an impaired GLP-2 response to meals is associated with intestinal barrier dysfunction, endotoxemia and NF-kB-mediated systemic inflammation and may promote renal dysfunction and CKD.
translations.translation_ko: 72주 뒤 GLP-2 반응 변화가 만성콩팥병 발생과 이어졌고(오즈비 0.49), 대사이상 지방간염에서 GLP-2 반응이 무뎌지면 장 장벽이 새고 염증이 생겼습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]).
translations.translation_ko: 장내 미생물 치료로 체질량지수와 간수치, 콜레스테롤이 줄었지만(-10.1 mg/dL), 염증 지표는 그대로였습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: However, patients sometimes do not respond effectively to treatment, and ‌adverse effects, including liver toxicity, accompany this therapy. ‌Accordingly, we decided to treat MS patients simultaneously with Silymarin (SM) as an immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective agent and IFN-β in a clinical trial study.
translations.translation_ko: 다발성경화증 치료가 잘 듣지 않고 간독성 같은 부작용이 따르는 경우가 있어, 실리마린을 인터페론 베타와 같이 써 봤습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Probiotics (MD: -6.42, 95% CI [-11.91 to -0.92]) and synbiotics (MD: -13.13, 95% CI [-20.82 to -5.45]) were both associated with a reduction in aspartate aminotransferase (AST) levels compared to placebo.
translations.translation_ko: 유산균(-6.42)과 신바이오틱스(-13.13) 모두 위약보다 간수치 AST 가 낮았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to reorganize randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD; including legacy NAFLD) into a clinical evidence-anchored knowledge graph (KG) and harmonize effect semantics ("unified effects") to support endpoint- and design-aware evidence navigation.
translations.translation_ko: 2형 당뇨병과 대사이상 지방간이 함께 있는 성인을 다룬 한의학 임상시험을 모아 지식 그래프로 정리했습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: TCM-related adverse events (mainly diarrhea and gastrointestinal discomfort) were mild and rare; 63.2% of studies reported no adverse events.
translations.translation_ko: 한약과 관련된 이상반응은 설사와 속 불편함 정도로 가볍고 드물었고, 연구의 63.2% 는 이상반응이 아예 없었다고 했습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Meta-analysis showed that YGJ or its modified versions, combined with Western medical supportive treatments, significantly increased treatment effectiveness (OR = 1.84, 95% CI: 1.32-2.58), improved Karnofsky performance status score (MD = 7.00, 95% CI: 4.80-9.21), decreased serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI: -0.58 to -0.14), improved TCM syndrome scores (MD = -3.10, 95% CI: -3.78 to -2.42), reduced total bilirubin (MD = -1.52, 95% CI: -2.25 to -0.78), and lowered gastrointestinal adverse reactions (OR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.33-0.84).
translations.translation_ko: YGJ 처방을 서양 치료와 같이 썼을 때 치료 반응이 늘고(오즈비 1.84) 일상 활동 점수가 좋아졌으며, 알파태아단백과 빌리루빈은 낮아졌습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: A fixed-dose regimen for 4-PCC administration provides benefits over a variable-dose regimen in terms of dose reduction, faster administration time, improved clinical hemostasis, and reduced mortality and thromboembolic events.
translations.translation_ko: 4인자 프로트롬빈 복합체를 정해진 용량으로 준 쪽이 몸무게에 맞춰 준 쪽보다 투여가 빨랐고 지혈이 나았으며 사망과 혈전 사건이 줄었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: There was no significant difference between groups for stroke or systemic embolic (SSE) events (RR 0.84; 95% CI 0.65 to 1.07; p = 0.157), stroke (RR 0.73; 95% CI 0.48 to 1.11; p = 0.140), systemic embolic (SE) events (RR 0.69; 95% CI 0.40 to 1.17; p = 0.166), thrombus resolution (RR 1.05; 95% CI 0.99 to 1.11; p = 0.077), any bleeding (RR 0.78; 95% CI 0.60 to 1.00; p = 0.054), clinically relevant bleeding (RR 0.69; 95% CI 0.46 to 1.03; p = 0.066), minor bleeding (RR 0.73; 95% CI 0.43 to 1.23; p = 0.234), major bleeding (RR 0.87; 95% CI 0.42 to 1.80; p = 0.705), and all-cause mortality (RR 1.05; 95% CI 0.79 to 1.39; p = 0.752).
translations.translation_ko: 여러 결과를 봤지만 뇌졸중, 색전증, 출혈, 사망 위험 어디에서도 뚜렷한 차이가 없었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: DOACs were associated with a lower risk of ≥30 % eGFR decline (HR:0.72, 95 %CI:0.59-0.88), progression to stage five CKD (HR:0.49,95 %CI:0.37-0.64) and doubling of serum creatinine (HR:0.50, 95 %CI:0.42-0.61). ≥30 % eGFR decline was also lower when apixaban, dabigatran and rivaroxaban were compared separately to VKAs, (HR:0.81, 95 %CI:0.69-0.95), (HR:0.61, 95 %CI:0.48-0.78) and (HR:0.80, 95 %CI:0.70-0.92) respectively.
translations.translation_ko: 직접작용 항응고제를 쓴 쪽에서 콩팥 기능이 30% 넘게 낮아질 위험이 적었습니다(위험비 0.72).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Studies of warfarin and aspirin showed that laboratory monitoring levels were frequently out of therapeutic range (variably defined), and findings were mixed on the association of these derangements with bleeding or thrombotic events.
translations.translation_ko: 와파린과 아스피린은 검사 수치가 치료 범위를 벗어나는 일이 잦았는데, 그것이 출혈이나 혈전으로 이어지는지는 연구마다 엇갈렸습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Higher-dose versus lower-dose anticoagulants (4 RCTs, 4647 participants) Higher-dose anticoagulants result in little or no difference in all-cause mortality (risk ratio (RR) 1.03, 95% CI 0.92 to 1.16, 4489 participants; 4 RCTs) and increase minor bleeding (RR 3.28, 95% CI 1.75 to 6.14, 1196 participants; 3 RCTs) compared to lower-dose anticoagulants up to 30 days (high-certainty evidence).
translations.translation_ko: 항응고제를 높은 용량으로 쓴 쪽은 낮은 용량과 견줘 사망 위험에 차이가 없었고, 가벼운 출혈만 늘었습니다(위험비 3.28).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Compared with the standard of care, DOACs had non-significant reductions in the rates of major bleeding (1.2% vs 2.4%; RD = -1%, 95%CI: -6% to 3%), intracranial hemorrhage (1.9% vs 3.6%; RD = -2%, 95%CI:-7% to 3%), clinically relevant non-major bleeding (3.8% vs 7.4%; RD = -4%, 95%CI:-9% to 2%), and any bleeding (17.3% vs 21.4%; RD = -4%, 95%CI:-16% to 8%) in patients with CVT.
translations.translation_ko: 뇌정맥혈전증에서 직접작용 항응고제를 쓴 쪽의 큰 출혈이 1.2%, 표준 치료가 2.4% 로 줄었지만 통계로 뚜렷하지는 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Compared to placebo or no treatment, renin-angiotensin system (RAS) inhibition probably decreases proteinuria (3 studies, 199 participants: MD - 0.71 g/24 h, 95% CI -1.04 to -0.39; moderate certainty evidence) but may result in little or no difference to kidney failure or doubling of serum creatinine (SCr), or complete remission of proteinuria (low certainty evidence).
translations.translation_ko: 레닌안지오텐신계 억제제를 쓴 쪽에서 단백뇨가 줄었지만(3개 연구, 199명), 신부전이나 혈청 크레아티닌 배가에서는 차이가 뚜렷하지 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Starting a NOAC on postoperative day 4 appeared to have similar bleeding rates compared with warfarin, but clinical application is limited by heterogeneity of outcome definitions, confounding, and bias.
translations.translation_ko: 수술 나흘째부터 새 경구 항응고제를 시작해도 와파린과 출혈 발생이 비슷했지만, 연구마다 기준이 달라 그대로 적용하기는 어렵습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: Non-vitamin K oral anticoagulants for intracranial haemorrhages and VKA-ICH occurring during secondary stroke prevention of AF patients have comparable baseline characteristics and outcomes except for the risk of fatal ICH within 30 days, which might be greater in VKA-ICH.
translations.translation_ko: 심방세동 환자의 뇌출혈에서 결과는 대체로 비슷했지만, 30일 안의 치명적 뇌출혈 위험은 비타민 K 길항제 쪽이 더 높을 수 있습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Significant risk factors for major bleeding during edoxaban treatment were female sex, concomitant antiplatelet therapy, haemoglobin ≤10 g/dl, history of arterial hypertension, and systolic blood pressure >160 mmHg.
translations.translation_ko: 에독사반을 먹는 동안 큰 출혈 위험이 높았던 조건은 여성, 항혈소판제 병용, 헤모글로빈 10 g/dl 이하, 고혈압, 수축기혈압 160 초과였습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: Compared with antiplatelet drugs alone, NOACs combined with antiplatelet drugs resulted in lower risk of ischemic stroke events (OR = 0.75, 95%CI 0.57-0.98, p = 0.03), while other treatment effects were not worse than those of single antiplatelet drugs (p ≥ 0.05).
translations.translation_ko: 항혈소판제만 쓴 쪽과 견줘 새 경구 항응고제를 같이 쓴 쪽의 허혈성 뇌졸중 위험이 낮았습니다(오즈비 0.75).
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: In terms of the safety outcomes, DOACs was associated with lower risks of major bleeding (RR = 0.70, 95%CI: 0.59-0.82) and intracranial bleeding (RR = 0.42, 95%CI: 0.26-0.70), but the risks of any bleeding (RR = 0.85, 95%CI: 0.65-1.13) and gastrointestinal bleeding (RR = 0.92, 95%CI: 0.73-1.17) are not significantly different when compared with VKAs.
translations.translation_ko: 직접작용 항응고제를 쓴 쪽에서 큰 출혈(0.70)과 뇌출혈(0.42) 위험이 낮았지만, 전체 출혈과 위장관 출혈은 차이가 없었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: In individuals with high-risk antiphospholipid antibody (aPL) profile without prior thrombotic or obstetric APS, two meta-analyses showed a protective effect of low-dose aspirin (LDA) against thrombosis.
translations.translation_ko: 항인지질항체 위험도가 높은 사람에서 저용량 아스피린이 혈전을 막아 줬다는 메타분석이 두 편 있었습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: RESULTS: DY-807f doses were safe and well-tolerated with no dose-dependent increase in adverse events up to 360 mg.
translations.translation_ko: DY-807f 는 360 mg 까지 용량을 올려도 이상반응이 늘지 않았고 잘 견뎠습니다.
translations.author: Claude

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
translations.translation_ko: 이코사펜트에틸 4 g/day 를 와파린 25 mg 과 같이 먹었을 때 와파린 혈중 농도와 항응고 효과는 달라지지 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude
